main.description: Hi everyone! Welcome to my website. Feel free to browse around to learn more about my education, work experience, projects and more!
main.bio: Hello! I'm Hashirr, an international student from Singapore currently pursuing my studies in Computer Science. I'm passionate about software development and artificial intelligence, and I love experimenting with various AI frameworks like IBM Watson, LLAMA, and others in my free time!
main.bio2: Beyond my academic and technical pursuits, I'm an avid badminton player and enjoy exploring the great outdoors through hiking. Whether I'm working on new coding projects or exploring new hobbies, I'm always looking for new ways to challenge myself and grow both personally and professionally.
main.bio3: Welcome to my personal website, where I share my projects, interests, and insights into the exciting world of technology!
main.contactmessage: Feel free to use the form below to get in touch with me, or you could reach out through LinkedIn or Email as well!

education.description: My academic journey at CU Boulder has been a blend of Computer Science, Business, and Leadership studies, providing me with a well-rounded skill set for the tech industry. In Computer Science, I progressed from foundational courses like Principles of Programming Languages (CSCI 3155) and Computer Systems (CSCI 2400) to advanced topics. A highlight was excelling in Algorithms (CSCI 3104) after an initial challenge, demonstrating my growth and determination. My capstone Software Engineering Project (CSCI 4308/4318) allowed me to apply my skills to real-world problems, exploring computer vision with Tensorflow.js and app development using React Native.
achievements: ~ CU Boulder New Venture Challenge Winner (2024): Led a team to victory in the prestigious New Venture Challenge, a highly competitive entrepreneurship competition against 100 teams. Successfully developed and pitched an innovative business plan, demonstrating strong leadership, strategic thinking, and persuasive communication skills.

~ CU Boulder Community Impact Award (2024): Honoring students who demonstrate exceptional dedication to community improvement through voluntary service, leadership, and inclusive initiatives. Award recognizes those who create lasting positive change through founding organizations, implementing service projects, and fostering inclusive environments.
